blocks.zh: 導言 — ISO 2859系列概覽
blocks.en: Foreword - Overview of the ISO 2859 Series

blocks.zh: Original Text 原文內容
Commentary & Context 解說與背景
What is ISO 2859-1? 什麼是ISO 2859-1？
ISO 2859-1是屬性允收抽樣的全球標準——根據對樣本的檢驗結果，以統計方法決定接受或拒絕一批產品。它在實質上與美國標準ANSI/ASQ Z1.4相同。
blocks.en: ISO 2859-1 is the international standard for attribute acceptance sampling: it uses statistical methods to decide, from the inspection results of a sample, whether to accept or reject a lot of product. It is substantively identical to the American standard ANSI/ASQ Z1.4.

blocks.zh: Analogy: The Restaurant Inspector 比喻：餐廳稽查員
想像衛生稽查員視察餐廳：不需品嚐每道菜，只需抽查幾道。若足夠多的樣本通過，則核發認證；若太多失敗，則加嚴審查甚至停業。ISO 2859-1正是將這個邏輯形式化，提供精確的統計保證。
blocks.en: Imagine a health inspector visiting a restaurant. They do not taste every dish; they check just a few. If enough samples pass, the restaurant is certified; if too many fail, the inspection becomes stricter or the restaurant may even be closed. ISO 2859-1 formalizes exactly this logic and provides precise statistical assurance.

blocks.zh: Part 1 vs. Part 2 vs. Part 3 各部分區別
Clause 1: Scope 範圍
What ISO 2859-1 covers and its intended application 標準的適用範圍
blocks.en: What ISO 2859-1 covers and its intended application

blocks.zh: Commentary 解說
Attribute Inspection vs. Variable Inspection 屬性 vs. 計量
屬性檢驗（本標準）：每個單位分為合格或不合格——二元結果。計量值檢驗（ISO 3951）：記錄每個單位的測量值——連續數據。屬性抽樣速度較快、成本較低，但統計效率低於計量值抽樣。
blocks.en: Attribute inspection (this standard): each unit is classified as conforming or nonconforming, a binary result. Variable inspection (ISO 3951): a measured value is recorded for each unit, giving continuous data. Attribute sampling is faster and cheaper, but statistically less efficient than variable sampling.

blocks.zh: Critical Limitation: Not for All Pharma Tests 重要限制
blocks.en: Critical Limitation: Not for All Pharma Tests

blocks.zh: Economic and Psychological Pressure 經濟與心理壓力
本標準刻意設計來改變供應商行為——不只是判定批次。若批次持續被拒絕（進入加嚴），你會面臨更高的檢驗成本、延誤，甚至被取消資格。這就是「經濟壓力」。心理壓力：知道你的客戶正在用更嚴格的標準監控每一批次。
blocks.en: This standard is deliberately designed to change supplier behavior, not merely to sentence lots. If lots are repeatedly rejected (moving to tightened inspection), you face higher inspection costs, delays, and even disqualification. This is the "economic pressure". The psychological pressure comes from knowing that your customer is monitoring every lot against a stricter standard.

blocks.zh: Clause 2: Normative References 引用標準
Supporting standards referenced by ISO 2859-1 本標準引用的支持標準
Referenced Documents 引用文件
ISO 3534-2: The Vocabulary Foundation 術語基礎
ISO 3534-2是ISO 2859-1所有統計術語的基礎參考標準。當ISO 2859-1重新定義或修改某個術語時，會明確指出與ISO 3534-2的差異。
blocks.en: ISO 3534-2 is the reference standard underlying all statistical terminology in ISO 2859-1. Where ISO 2859-1 redefines or modifies a term, it states explicitly how it differs from ISO 3534-2.

blocks.zh: ISO 2859 vs. ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 兩個標準的關係
blocks.en: ISO 2859 vs. ANSI/ASQ Z1.4: How the Two Standards Relate

blocks.zh: ANSI/ASQ Z1.4（美國）與ISO 2859-1（國際）在技術上等同——相同的表格、相同的切換規則、相同的理念。在FDA監管環境中，兩者均可接受。
blocks.en: ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 (US) and ISO 2859-1 (international) are technically equivalent: the same tables, the same switching rules, the same philosophy. In an FDA-regulated environment, both are acceptable.

blocks.zh: Clause 3: Terms, Definitions and Symbols 術語、定義與符號
The most important clause — defines 28+ technical terms 最重要的條款——定義28個以上的技術術語
blocks.en: The most important clause: it defines more than 28 technical terms

blocks.zh: Why Clause 3 Matters Most 為何第3條最重要
第3條是整個標準的概念基礎。幾乎所有關於AQL程式的爭議都源於對這些術語的誤解——尤其是AQL本身，常被誤認為品質目標。
blocks.en: Clause 3 is the conceptual foundation of the whole standard. Almost every dispute about AQL schemes stems from misunderstanding these terms, especially AQL itself, which is often mistaken for a quality target.

blocks.zh: 3.1 Lot and Sample Concepts 批次與樣本概念
一定量的產品、材料或服務的集合體。注：一個檢驗批可由若干個生產批或生產批的一部分組成。
blocks.en: A collection of product, material, or service. Note: an inspection lot may consist of several production lots or parts of production lots.

blocks.zh: 3.1.14 Lot Size N (批量)
批中的項目數量。符號：N
blocks.en: The number of items in a lot. Symbol: N

blocks.zh: 3.1.15 Sample (樣本)
從批中抽取的一個或多個項目的集合，用於提供關於該批的信息。
blocks.en: A set of one or more items taken from a lot and intended to provide information about the lot.

blocks.zh: 3.1.16 Sample Size n (樣本量)
樣本中的項目數量。符號：n
blocks.en: The number of items in a sample. Symbol: n

blocks.zh: Lot vs. Batch in Pharma 製藥中批次與生產批的區別
製藥中「生產批」指特定的生產運行。ISO 2859-1下的「檢驗批」可能是一個收到的玻璃瓶生產批，或可能是合並自多次交貨以形成統計上有意義的批次。關鍵規則：批次應由相同類型、等級、類別、尺寸和成分的項目組成，在實質上相同時間在均一條件下製造。
blocks.en: In pharma, a "batch" refers to a specific production run. An "inspection lot" under ISO 2859-1 may be one received glass vial batch, or may be combined from several deliveries to form a statistically meaningful lot. Key rule: a lot should consist of items of a single type, grade, class, size, and composition, manufactured under uniform conditions at essentially the same time.

blocks.zh: 3.1.17–3.1.19: Sampling Plan, Scheme, and System 3.1.17–3.1.19：抽樣計畫、方案與系統
3.1.17 Sampling Plan (抽樣計畫)
抽樣計畫是樣本量與相應批允收準則的組合。它不包含如何抽取樣本的規則。
blocks.en: A sampling plan is a combination of sample size(s) and the associated lot acceptance criteria. It does not include rules for how the sample is to be drawn.

blocks.zh: 3.1.18 Sampling Scheme (抽樣方案)
抽樣方案是抽樣計畫的組合，加上從一個計畫切換到另一個計畫的規則。第9條的切換規則定義了方案。
blocks.en: A sampling scheme is a combination of sampling plans together with rules for switching from one plan to another. The switching rules of Clause 9 define the scheme.

blocks.zh: 3.1.19 Sampling System (抽樣系統)
Plan vs. Scheme vs. System — The Hierarchy 計畫、方案、系統的層次
blocks.en: Plan vs. Scheme vs. System: The Hierarchy

blocks.zh: 大多數QA人員日常工作在計畫層面，但方案（切換規則）才是為供應商創造長期激勵結構的關鍵。
blocks.en: Most QA staff work at the plan level day to day, but it is the scheme (the switching rules) that creates the long-term incentive structure for suppliers.

blocks.zh: Single vs. Double vs. Multiple Sampling 單次、雙次、多次抽樣
blocks.en: Single vs. Double vs. Multiple Sampling

blocks.zh: 3.1.26–3.1.28 + 3.1.20–3.1.23: AQL, Switching States, and Risk 3.1.26–3.1.28 + 3.1.20–3.1.23：AQL、切換狀態與風險
3.1.26 Acceptance Quality Limit (AQL) 允收品質界限
允收品質界限（AQL）是在對一連續系列的批進行允收抽樣時，能被容忍的最差的製程平均。注：AQL的指定並不意味著這是一個理想的品質水準。
blocks.en: The acceptance quality limit (AQL) is the worst tolerable process average when a continuing series of lots is submitted for acceptance sampling. Note: specifying an AQL does not imply that this is a desirable quality level.

blocks.zh: 3.1.27 Consumer's Risk Quality (CRQ) 消費者風險品質
對應於特定消費者風險的批或製程品質水準。消費者風險通常為10%（即接受此品質水準批次的概率為10%）。
blocks.en: The quality level of a lot or process that corresponds to a specified consumer's risk. The consumer's risk is usually 10% (that is, a lot at this quality level has a 10% probability of being accepted).

blocks.zh: 3.1.25 Process Average 製程平均
製程平均：在定義的時間段或生產量上的製程水準平均值。
blocks.en: Process average: the average level of the process over a defined period or quantity of production.

blocks.zh: AQL: The Most Misunderstood Term AQL：最被誤解的術語
AQL不是您的品質目標。AQL是您認為可容忍的供應商製程平均上限。若供應商的製程平均等於AQL，他們將面臨頻繁的拒絕。實際目標應比AQL好得多。
blocks.en: The AQL is not your quality target. The AQL is the upper limit of supplier process average that you consider tolerable. If a supplier's process average equals the AQL, they will face frequent rejections. The real target should be much better than the AQL.

blocks.zh: Producer's Risk and Consumer's Risk 生產者風險與消費者風險

Producer's Risk (α, Type I Error):
Probability of REJECTING a "good" lot
(a lot whose true quality equals the AQL)
Typical α = 5%

Consumer's Risk (β, Type II Error):
Probability of ACCEPTING a "bad" lot
(a lot at Consumer's Risk Quality CRQ)
Typical β = 10%

生產者風險（α，型一錯誤）：
拒絕「好批」的概率（真實品質=AQL的批）
典型α = 5%

消費者風險（β，型二錯誤）：
接受「壞批」的概率（批處於CRQ水準）
典型β = 10%
blocks.en:
Producer's Risk (α, Type I Error):
Probability of REJECTING a "good" lot
(a lot whose true quality equals the AQL)
Typical α = 5%

Consumer's Risk (β, Type II Error):
Probability of ACCEPTING a "bad" lot
(a lot at Consumer's Risk Quality CRQ)
Typical β = 10%

blocks.zh: 3.1.5–3.1.11: Nonconformity Concepts 不合格概念
3.1.5 Nonconformity (不合格)
不符合規定要求。注：按嚴重程度分類——A類（最嚴重，最小AQL）、B類、C類等。
blocks.en: Non-fulfilment of a specified requirement. Note: nonconformities are classified by seriousness: Class A (most serious, smallest AQL), Class B, Class C, and so on.

blocks.zh: 3.1.6 Defect (缺陷)
不符合預期使用要求。「缺陷」與使用有關（而非僅規格符合性）。由於法律含義，「不合格」是首選的通用術語。
blocks.en: Non-fulfilment of an intended usage requirement. A "defect" relates to use (not merely conformance to specification). Because of its legal connotations, "nonconformity" is the preferred general term.

blocks.zh: 3.1.7 Nonconforming Item (不合格品)
含有一個或多個不合格的項目。按嚴重程度分類：A類品含有一個或多個A類不合格；B類品含有B類但不含A類不合格。
blocks.en: An item with one or more nonconformities. Classified by seriousness: a Class A item contains one or more Class A nonconformities; a Class B item contains Class B but no Class A nonconformities.

blocks.zh: Multiple Classifications Require Multiple Plans 多種分類需要多個計畫
實際操作中，同一批次的同一樣本同時執行多個抽樣計畫——嚴重、主要、次要各一個。若任一分類失敗，批次即被拒絕。
blocks.en: In practice, several sampling plans are applied simultaneously to the same sample from the same lot: one each for critical, major, and minor. If any one class fails, the lot is not accepted.

blocks.zh: Pharma Critical/Major/Minor Classification 製藥嚴重/主要/次要分類
3.2 Key Symbols and Abbreviations 關鍵符號與縮寫
Ac vs. Re — The Acceptance Decision Rule Ac vs. Re——允收判定規則
blocks.en: Ac vs. Re: The Acceptance Decision Rule

blocks.zh: 對於單次抽樣計畫：檢驗n個項目，計算d=找到的不合格品數。若d≤Ac→接受批次；若d≥Re→拒絕批次。在所有標準單次計畫中，Re = Ac + 1，沒有「灰色地帶」。
blocks.en: For a single sampling plan: inspect n items and count d = the number of nonconforming items found. If d ≤ Ac, accept the lot; if d ≥ Re, reject the lot. In all standard single plans, Re = Ac + 1, so there is no "gray zone".

blocks.zh: Switching Score 切換分數
切換分數（3.1.23）是用於確定是否有資格進行放寬檢驗的運行計數器。類似汽車保險的「無索賠獎金」——每個「輕鬆通過」的批次（即即使AQL更緊也能通過）加分。累積到30分，可享放寬檢驗優惠。任何拒絕將分數重置為零。
blocks.en: The switching score (3.1.23) is a running counter used to determine eligibility for reduced inspection. It works like a "no-claims bonus" in car insurance: every lot that passes "comfortably" (that is, would also have passed at the next tighter AQL) earns points. On reaching 30 points, you qualify for reduced inspection. Any rejection resets the score to zero.

blocks.zh: Clause 4: Expression of Nonconformity 不合格的表示方式
4.1 General 一般原則
4.2 Classification of Nonconformities 不合格分類
Percent Nonconforming vs. Per 100 Items 兩種計量方式的區別
blocks.en: Percent Nonconforming vs. Per 100 Items: Two Ways of Measuring

blocks.zh: Pharma Application: Glass Vial Inspection 製藥應用：玻璃瓶檢驗
對於玻璃瓶，單個單位可能有多個缺陷。在「不合格品百分率」下，這算作一個不合格品。在分類系統下，瓶子由其最嚴重的缺陷類別決定——一個A類缺陷使其成為A類不合格品。
blocks.en: A single glass vial may have several defects. Under "percent nonconforming", this counts as one nonconforming item. Under a classification system, the vial is assigned the class of its most serious defect: one Class A defect makes it a Class A nonconforming item.

blocks.zh: Clause 5: Acceptance Quality Limit (AQL) 允收品質界限
Preferred AQL values, specification, and critical caution 優選AQL值、規定與重要注意事項
blocks.en: Preferred AQL values, specification, and critical caution

blocks.zh: 5.1 Use and Application 使用與應用
5.2 Specifying AQLs 規定AQL
5.3 Preferred AQL Series 優選AQL系列
AQL Is an Index, Not a Quality Target AQL是索引，不是品質目標
blocks.en: AQL Is an Index, Not a Quality Target

blocks.zh: AQL最重要的概念：AQL用於選擇抽樣計畫，不是定義您想要的品質。指定AQL 0.65%時，您是在說：「我想要一個抽樣計畫，如果供應商的長期缺陷率接近0.65%，切換規則將觸發加嚴檢驗。」您對供應商的實際期望可能是0.05%或更好。
blocks.en: The most important idea about AQL: the AQL is used to select a sampling plan; it does not define the quality you want. When you specify an AQL of 0.65%, you are saying: "I want a sampling plan under which, if the supplier's long-term defect rate approaches 0.65%, the switching rules will trigger tightened inspection." What you actually expect of the supplier may be 0.05% or better.

blocks.zh: Why These Specific AQL Values? 為什麼是這些特定值？
優選系列是對數等距的——每步約為前一個的1.585倍。使用非優選AQL（如0.5%）意味著任何表格均不適用，需要自定義計畫生成——實際操作上存在重大不便。
blocks.en: The preferred series is geometrically spaced, with each step about 1.585 times the previous one. Using a non-preferred AQL (such as 0.5%) means no table applies and a custom plan must be generated, which is a significant practical inconvenience.

blocks.zh: Standard Pharma AQL Levels 製藥標準AQL水準
Clause 6: Submission of Product for Sampling 產品的提交
blocks.en: Clause 6: Submission of Product for Sampling

blocks.zh: Lot formation rules and presentation requirements 批次形成規則與提交要求
blocks.en: Lot formation rules and presentation requirements

blocks.zh: 6.1 Formation of Lots 批次形成
6.2 Presentation of Lots 批次提交
Lot Formation in CDMO Incoming Inspection CDMO來料檢驗的批次形成
blocks.en: Lot Formation in CDMO Incoming Inspection

blocks.zh: 關鍵決策：如果不同模腔或不同生產日的缺陷模式可能不同，不要將其混合成一個批次。若混合不可避免，可使用分層抽樣（第8.1條）。
blocks.en: Key decision: if defect patterns may differ between mold cavities or production days, do not mix them into a single lot. If mixing is unavoidable, stratified sampling (Clause 8.1) can be used.

blocks.zh: Lot Size Determination 批量確定
批量直接決定樣本量碼字（ISO 2859-1第1表），進而決定n、Ac和Re。批量越大→樣本量越大（但抽樣比例下降）；批量越小→樣本量越小但抽樣比例越高。
blocks.en: Lot size directly determines the sample size code letter (ISO 2859-1 Table 1), which in turn determines n, Ac, and Re. The larger the lot, the larger the sample size (but the lower the sampling fraction); the smaller the lot, the smaller the sample size but the higher the sampling fraction.

blocks.zh: Clause 7: Acceptance and Non-acceptance 允收與不允收
Lot sentencing rules, disposition of non-acceptable lots, resubmission 批次判定、不合格批次處置、重新提交
blocks.en: Lot sentencing rules, disposition of non-acceptable lots, resubmission

blocks.zh: 7.1 Acceptability of Lots 批次允收性
7.2 Disposition of Non-acceptable Lots 不允收批次的處置
Scrapped 報廢
Sorted (with or without nonconforming items being replaced) 揀選
blocks.en: Sorted (with or without nonconforming items being replaced)

blocks.zh: Reworked 返工
Re-evaluated against more specific usability criteria 重新評估
blocks.en: Re-evaluated against more specific usability criteria

blocks.zh: Held for additional information 暫扣待查
7.3 Nonconforming Items Found in Accepted Lots 已允收批中發現的不合格品
blocks.en: 7.3 Nonconforming Items Found in Accepted Lots

blocks.zh: 7.5 Special Reservation for Critical Classes 嚴重類不合格的特別保留條款
7.6 Resubmitted Lots 重新提交的批次
Non-acceptance ≠ Rejection — A Subtle Distinction 不允收≠拒絕
ISO 2859-1在描述抽樣程序的統計結果時使用「不允收」，在描述消費者採取的行動時使用「拒絕」（例如拒收數Re）。區別很重要——「不允收」的批次不一定有缺陷；它只是樣本未達到允收標準。
blocks.en: ISO 2859-1 uses "non-acceptance" to describe the statistical outcome of the sampling procedure, and "rejection" to describe the action taken by the consumer (for example, the rejection number Re). The distinction matters: a "non-acceptable" lot is not necessarily defective; it simply failed to meet the acceptance criteria on the sample.

blocks.zh: Disposition Decision Tree 處置決策樹
100% Inspection for Critical Defects 嚴重缺陷的全數檢驗
Clause 8: Drawing of Samples 樣本的抽取
Random sampling requirement and stratified sampling rules 隨機抽樣要求與分層抽樣規則
blocks.en: Random sampling requirement and stratified sampling rules

blocks.zh: 8.1 Sample Selection 樣本選取
8.2 Time for Drawing the Samples 抽樣時間
8.3 Double or Multiple Sampling 雙次或多次抽樣
Random Sampling in Practice 隨機抽樣的實際操作
絕對不要只從第一個箱子的頂部抽樣——這是最常見的AQL審計發現，違反了隨機性要求。
blocks.en: Never sample only from the top of the first carton. This is the most common AQL audit finding and violates the randomness requirement.

blocks.zh: Stratified vs. Simple Random — When It Matters 分層 vs. 簡單隨機——何時重要
blocks.en: Stratified vs. Simple Random: When It Matters

blocks.zh: 如果一個托盤的瓶子由3個不同的供應商批次組成，簡單隨機抽樣可能偶然過度抽取一個批次。分層抽樣強制按比例代表。
blocks.en: If a pallet of vials consists of 3 different supplier batches, simple random sampling may over-sample one batch by chance. Stratified sampling forces proportional representation.

Switching Rules as a Supplier Feedback Loop 切換規則作為供應商反饋迴路
blocks.en: Switching Rules as a Supplier Feedback Loop

blocks.zh: 這反映了製藥供應商升級SOP：審計發現→CAPA→重新資格確認。ISO 2859-1切換規則提供了統計觸發點。
blocks.en: This mirrors the supplier escalation SOP in pharma: audit finding → CAPA → requalification. The ISO 2859-1 switching rules provide the statistical triggers.

blocks.zh: Independent Switching per Defect Class 每個缺陷類別獨立切換
切換程序對每類不合格獨立應用。供應商可能同時處於嚴重缺陷正常、主要缺陷加嚴、次要缺陷放寬的狀態。切換分數必須按類別分別跟蹤。
blocks.en: The switching procedure is applied independently to each class of nonconformity. A supplier may be on normal inspection for critical defects, tightened for major defects, and reduced for minor defects at the same time. Switching scores must be tracked separately for each class.

blocks.zh: Switching Score Example 切換分數計算範例

Scenario: AQL 0.65%, n=80, Ac=2, Re=3 (single sampling)
One-step tighter AQL = 0.40%, which has Ac=1 for same n

Lot 1: d=1 (would pass at AQL 0.40, Ac=1)  → Score: 0+3=3
Lot 2: d=0 (would pass at AQL 0.40, Ac=1)  → Score: 3+3=6
Lot 3: d=2 (would FAIL at AQL 0.40, Ac=1) → Score: RESET to 0
Lot 4: d=0 → Score: 0+3=3
Lot 5: d=1 → Score: 3+3=6
Lot 6: d=0 → Score: 6+3=9
...
[10 lots later, score reaches ≥30]
→ Check all 3 conditions for Reduced
→ If production is steady and authority approves → switch to Reduced

以AQL 0.65%，n=80，Ac=2，Re=3為例：
每批「在更緊AQL下也能通過」則加3分；否則重置為0。
積累到≥30分，加上穩定生產和主管批准，即可切換至放寬。
blocks.en:
Scenario: AQL 0.65%, n=80, Ac=2, Re=3 (single sampling)
One-step tighter AQL = 0.40%, which has Ac=1 for same n

Lot 1: d=1 (would pass at AQL 0.40, Ac=1)  → Score: 0+3=3
Lot 2: d=0 (would pass at AQL 0.40, Ac=1)  → Score: 3+3=6
Lot 3: d=2 (would FAIL at AQL 0.40, Ac=1) → Score: RESET to 0
Lot 4: d=0 → Score: 0+3=3
Lot 5: d=1 → Score: 3+3=6
Lot 6: d=0 → Score: 6+3=9
...
[10 lots later, score reaches ≥30]
→ Check all 3 conditions for Reduced
→ If production is steady and authority approves → switch to Reduced

Example with AQL 0.65%, n=80, Ac=2, Re=3:
Each lot that "would also pass at the tighter AQL" adds 3 points; otherwise the score resets to 0.
On reaching ≥30 points, together with steady production and authority approval, you may switch to reduced inspection.

blocks.zh: Tightened Inspection in Pharma 製藥中的加嚴檢驗
加嚴檢驗有兩個效果：（1）允收標準更嚴格；（2）對供應商的心理/經濟壓力增加。在CDMO情境中，觸發加嚴也應自動啟動供應商品質通知，要求根本原因分析和CAPA。
blocks.en: Tightened inspection has two effects: (1) the acceptance criteria become stricter; (2) the psychological and economic pressure on the supplier increases. In a CDMO setting, triggering tightened inspection should also automatically initiate a supplier quality notification requiring root cause analysis and CAPA.

blocks.zh: Worked Example: Step-by-Step Sampling Plan Selection 實例演算：逐步選擇抽樣計畫
blocks.en: Worked Example: Step-by-Step Sampling Plan Selection

blocks.zh: Glass vial incoming inspection — complete walkthrough 玻璃瓶來料檢驗——完整演算過程
blocks.en: Glass vial incoming inspection: complete walkthrough

blocks.zh: Scenario 情境設定
您是無菌分裝CDMO的來料QC主任。供應商交付了15,000支2 mL注射用玻璃瓶。您需要為正常檢驗建立適當的單次抽樣計畫。
blocks.en: You are the incoming QC supervisor at a sterile fill-finish CDMO. A supplier has delivered 15,000 2 mL glass vials for injection. You need to establish an appropriate single sampling plan for normal inspection.

blocks.zh: Step 1: Determine the Lot Size 第一步：確定批量
Step 2: Select the Inspection Level 第二步：選擇檢驗水準
決定：使用通用水準II——這是默認水準，適用於玻璃瓶目視檢驗。
blocks.en: Decision: use General Level II. This is the default level and is suitable for visual inspection of glass vials.

blocks.zh: Step 3: Find the Sample Size Code Letter 第三步：查找樣本量碼字
blocks.en: Step 3: Find the Sample Size Code Letter

blocks.zh: Step 4: Identify Sample Size n 第四步：確定樣本量n
碼字M對應n = 315件
blocks.en: Code letter M corresponds to n = 315 items

blocks.zh: Step 5: Select AQL and Find Ac/Re 第五步：選擇AQL並查找Ac/Re
blocks.en: Step 5: Select AQL and Find Ac/Re

blocks.zh: 注：三種類別均使用同一個315件的樣本。樣本量由最嚴格的AQL確定；同一樣本根據三組允收標準進行評估。
blocks.en: Note: the same 315-item sample is used for all three classes. The sample size is determined by the strictest AQL; the same sample is evaluated against the three sets of acceptance criteria.

blocks.zh: Step 6: Draw the Sample 第六步：抽取樣本
從整批中使用分層隨機抽樣抽取315支瓶子。記錄抽樣程序。
blocks.en: Draw 315 vials from the whole lot using stratified random sampling. Document the sampling procedure.

blocks.zh: Step 7: Inspect and Record 第七步：檢驗並記錄
結果：批次不允收——因為次要缺陷超過Ac=14（d=18 ≥ Re=15）。
blocks.en: Result: lot not acceptable, because the minor defects exceed Ac=14 (d=18 ≥ Re=15).

blocks.zh: Step 8: Switching Score Update 第八步：更新切換分數
此批次在原始檢驗中被拒絕。所有發生拒絕的類別的切換分數重置為0。如果這是連續5批中的第2次拒絕，則該類別必須切換至加嚴檢驗。
blocks.en: This lot was rejected on original inspection. The switching score is reset to 0 for every class in which a rejection occurred. If this is the 2nd rejection within 5 consecutive lots, that class must switch to tightened inspection.

Why NOT Use AQL for Sterility Testing 為什麼不應將AQL用於無菌測試
blocks.en: Why NOT Use AQL for Sterility Testing

blocks.zh: 同理，內毒素測試（BET/LAL）遵循USP <85>/Ph.Eur. 2.6.14的固定抽樣要求，不使用AQL。微粒物質測試遵循USP <788>/<789>。這些測試的抽樣邏輯與AQL完全不同。
blocks.en: Likewise, endotoxin testing (BET/LAL) follows the fixed sampling requirements of USP <85>/Ph.Eur. 2.6.14 and does not use AQL. Particulate matter testing follows USP <788>/<789>. The sampling logic of these tests is entirely different from AQL.

blocks.zh: Supplier Qualification Integration 與供應商資格整合
AQL in Quality Agreements AQL在品質協議中的地位
AQL值、檢驗水準、缺陷分類和切換規則應全部在CDMO與物料供應商之間的品質協議中明確規定。
blocks.en: The AQL values, inspection levels, defect classifications, and switching rules should all be specified explicitly in the quality agreement between the CDMO and the material supplier.
